answer.summary: Asks if insurance is accepted for sports massage
answer.reply:
Hi James,

Thanks for getting in touch with Harbourline Physio. We accept most major health insurers, so please bring your policy number to your appointment.

You can book a sports massage here: harbourlinephysio.test/book

The Harbourline Physio team
